title: should render the no-access empty state on the dashboards list when the list API returns 403
verifies: a 403 on the dashboards list API swaps the table to the 'You don't have access' empty state (copy + lock illustration, no CTA, first-run empty suppressed)

title: should render the no-access empty state on the alerts list when the list API returns 403
verifies: a 403 on the alerts list API renders the no-access empty state with copy and no create-alert CTA

title: should not render the no-access state for an authorized dashboards list
verifies: an authorized (200) dashboards list renders rows or the first-run empty state, never the no-access state
